Contract CoCoMEOrderProducts::makeNewOrder(orderid: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		orderProduct: OrderProduct = OrderProduct.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = orderid)
	precondition:
		orderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = true or
		orderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false
	postcondition:
		let newOrderProduct: OrderProduct in
		newOrderProduct.oclIsNew() and
		newOrderProduct.Id = orderid and
		newOrderProduct.OrderStatus = OrderStatus::NEW and
		newOrderProduct.Time = self.now and
		OrderProduct.allInstance()->includes(newOrderProduct) and
		result = true or
		(orderProduct.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		result = true)
}
